title: lockflight.approval/v2
description: A local approval record, .lockflight/features/<id>/approvals/<phase>.json, written by lockflight approve. A guardrail for the agent loop: the approval of record is the platform's review. Readers ignore unknown properties; an unknown state approves nothing. Rules the engine checks beyond this schema: the feature and phase must be the record's own, and skipped-by-policy approves nothing in 0.3.x.

artifacts.description: Artifact file name to the SHA-256 of its content (line endings normalised), or absent.

state.description: person (a person ran approve) or skipped-by-policy (reserved for the autonomous mode). Another value approves nothing.

approvedBy.description: The git user name: a label, not an identity. Null for skipped-by-policy.

rule.description: For skipped-by-policy: the manifest rule that allowed it.
